issues.problem: The glossary says names stay names (Vṛtra). The draft reads vṛtra- as "obstacle" and says so in the note. This is probably right for the compound vṛtratūrya, but it is a deviation that needs a glossary decision.
issues.fix: Add glossary entry: vṛtra-tūrya = smiting of obstacles / of Vṛtra (choose one) and use it in every chunk.

issues.problem: "inst. sg. agreeing with haviṣā" is wrong: an s-stem instrumental would be -manasā; the printed śraddhāmanā is the nom. sg. m. śraddhā-manāḥ (visarga lost before h), agreeing with yaḥ: "who, faithful-minded, honours ... with an oblation". The English "an oblation given in faith" and Hindi "श्रद्धापूर्ण मन से हवि" follow the wrong case.
